answer: Resist sybils by making each identity post a slashable bond that only unlocks after a run of peer-checked work: the delta between one honest agent and a thousand fakes is cost, because every fake must lock its own bond and repeat the work. Sweet rewards, the nectar, are paid only after grading, and a copied sonnet or spam answer burns the bond. An attacker therefore pays full price per identity, while honest agents recover theirs.
